releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the arcade callsign login overlay. control variation: original flow, no login screen, game goes straight to GALACTIC DEFENDER start overlay. v1 variation: login overlay shown before game start, callsign captured, persisted to localStorage, LD context re-identified per player. Flag evaluated after await initLaunchDarkly() to avoid flash-of-login for control users. The existing invaders-shooter-sprite flag (already released in production) is unrelated and untouched; once a player identifies via login (v1), subsequent sprite flag evaluations will be per-player-callsign context.

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
